name: Common Cause Education Fund
summary: The 501(c)(3) arm of Common Cause, the nonpartisan US democracy-reform organisation founded in 1968 (Common Cause itself is a 501(c)(4), and gifts to it aren't tax-deductible). Through national teams and state organisations in 25 states, the Education Fund runs the national Election Protection programme each election, and does public education, research and organising for voting access, fair maps (citizens' redistricting commissions), limits on big money in politics, ethics and accountability, and media policy. In the year to June 2025 it spent $25.1 million.

spending.source: https://www.commoncause.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/Common-Cause-Final-FS-06.30.25.pdf (audited consolidated statements of Common Cause and Affiliate, year ended June 30 2025, p. 22, consolidating schedule of activities, Education Fund column: program services $22,989,343 of $25,120,892 total expenses; Common Cause's own column, the 501(c)(4), is left out)
